visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a light blue sleeveless high-neck top and dark leggings, stands in front of a blue backdrop with a 'Welcome to Seoul' graphic and a cartoon cat illustration. She holds a white shopping bag aloft, smiling brightly with a joyful facial expression. (2) Close-up shot of a rectangular yellow backlit sign with the black text 'VICXXO GALLERY'. The lighting is bright and industrial. (3) The woman stands in a brightly lit retail store surrounded by rows of colorful phone cases. She cycles through showing different phone cases: a pink one with illustrations, a blue one with a dog, and a green landscape one, holding them close to her face and winking. (4) Close-up view of hands meticulously peeling a green sticker featuring white flowers and a rabbit from a transparent phone case backing. Text overlays appear at the top. (5) The woman points excitedly toward a large display wall covered in dozens of unique phone cases and Korean text descriptions. She gestures with open palms toward the variety of choices. (6) Close-up shots of various phone accessories being demonstrated: a magnetic card holder with yellow flowers on an orange phone, a 3D cat pop-socket holding a green drink, and a rotating decision wheel accessory. (7) The video concludes with the woman in the original Seoul-themed setting, posing dynamically with one leg raised and a fist in the air, maintaining an energetic and welcoming smile.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 大博！這真的應該是我今年收到 最棒的聖誕禮物。 [Logo]: VICXXO GALLERY. (2) [Slogan]: 不用飛韓國 VICXXO Gallery 桃園統領/新竹巨城 也有門市！ [Subtitle]: 在台灣也可以買到 VICXXO 的手機殼. (3) [Subtitle]: 身為一個重度抉擇困難患者 來到這裡可以把 所有的願望一次滿足哦 因為他們家的背板貼紙 可以重複黏貼更換. (4) [Slogan]: 此樣式為IU同款手機殼. (5) [Subtitle]: 只要花一半手機殼的錢 就可以擁有不同的風格 不管是插畫的、療癒、鏡面的. (6) [Variety]: 哎！這個好像可以照個鏡子. (7) [Subtitle]: 小孩才做選擇 我！全都要！. (8) [Slogan]: 開幕限定 滿額禮遇 3件9折優惠. (9) [Subtitle]: VICXXO 除了手機殼 還有各種療癒小物 你們看這個卡套 超級穩固超級實用 還有這個 好適合和朋友一起玩今天誰買單 甚至可以幫同事 決定今天午餐吃什麼？. (10) [Subtitle]: 今晚，我想來點 VICXXO 手機殼 一起去逛吧 여러분.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice greeting the audience over an upbeat, synthetic pop BGM with a strong percussive beat. (2) A 'pop' sound effect triggers as a product name is mentioned, followed by a slight rise in vocal pitch. (3) Rapid speech delivery continues as the narrator describes store locations, accompanied by quick 'whoosh' transition sounds. (4) A melodic 'ding' sounds when a special feature (IU style) is highlighted. The BGM remains consistent in tempo. (5) Multiple 'bubble pop' SFX are heard in quick succession as different phone case styles are listed. (6) A mechanical 'click' sound is synchronized with the demonstration of phone accessories like the card holder and pop-socket. (7) The narrator's arousal peaks during the final call to action, ending with a celebratory vocal tone as the BGM hits a final chord.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Feature Presentation -> Benefit Explanation -> Accessory Showcase -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional endorsement for 'VICXXO GALLERY', a retail store specializing in Korean-style mobile accessories. It aims to drive foot traffic to its Taiwan locations by highlighting the variety, customizability, and functional benefits of their phone cases and accessories through an energetic, lifestyle-focused vlog format.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of the brand 'VICXXO', showing the physical store, products, and providing specific location and discount information.
